Name: (CP) Upgraded Kegs
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Upgraded Versions of the original Keg, with improved space efficiency. The Kegs come in Copper which take a stack of 1-10 of the same item, Iron which takes 11-25, Gold which takes 26-50 and Iridium which takes 51-100. If enabled in the config, there is also a Prismatic version which takes 101-200.

This is meant to be a Content Patcher replacement for the Custom Farming Redux [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4380]Mod[/url].


Based off of the PFM [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5180]conversion[/url] by Fox536 with tweaks, fixes and improvements by myself.


Purchase the crafting recipe for them from Clint. The first tier becomes available when the recipe for the vanilla kegs is unlocked.



Fully compatible with 1.6 and doesn't rely on anything else other than Content Patcher, Extra Machine Config & SMAPI.



Compatible with:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia Artisan Machines[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8684]Grapes of Ferngill[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15333]Copper Still[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23146]More Sensible Juices
